selected_evidence.requirement: HTTPS on TCP 8443 returns the required content using a system-trusted certificate
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after reboot, direct requests to 10.100.63.10:8443 returned HTTP 200, exact body `secure-os-comparison-ready`, and `ssl_verify_result=0`; certificate verification reported OK.

Captured healthy baseline with boot ID 717db5a2-895d-4bfb-b8a8-d4891c7b7b01, received native reboot acknowledgement, observed changed boot ID 352b95fb-e90e-42ba-b10e-1c6f65f3f974, then confirmed system health, enabled/active Apache, listener, firewall persistence, trusted TLS, and content recovery.

commands.command:
set -eu
umask 077
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:3072 -out /etc/pki/tls/private/infraset-local-root-ca.key >/dev/null 2>&1
openssl req -x509 -new -sha256 -days 3650 -key /etc/pki/tls/private/infraset-local-root-ca.key -out /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/infraset-local-root-ca.crt -subj '/CN=InfraSet node1 Local Root CA' -addext 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE' -addext 'keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign' -addext 'subjectKeyIdentifier=hash'
openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:3072 -out /etc/pki/tls/private/https-8443.key >/dev/null 2>&1
openssl req -new -sha256 -key /etc/pki/tls/private/https-8443.key -out /run/https-8443.csr -subj "/CN=$NODE_IP"
printf '%s\n' 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:FALSE' 'keyUsage=critical,digitalSignature,keyEncipherment' 'extendedKeyUsage=serverAuth' "subjectAltName=IP:$NODE_IP,DNS:$NODE_NAME,DNS:localhost,IP:127.0.0.1" 'subjectKeyIdentifier=hash' 'authorityKeyIdentifier=keyid,issuer' > /run/https-8443.ext
openssl x509 -req -in /run/https-8443.csr -CA /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/infraset-local-root-ca.crt -CAkey /etc/pki/tls/private/infraset-local-root-ca.key -CAcreateserial -out /etc/pki/tls/certs/https-8443.crt -days 825 -sha256 -extfile /run/https-8443.ext
chmod 600 /etc/pki/tls/private/infraset-local-root-ca.key /etc/pki/tls/private/https-8443.key
chmod 644 /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/infraset-local-root-ca.crt /etc/pki/tls/certs/https-8443.crt
restorecon -RF /etc/pki/tls/private /etc/pki/tls/certs /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors
update-ca-trust
rm -f /run/https-8443.csr /run/https-8443.ext /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/infraset-local-root-ca.srl
openssl verify /etc/pki/tls/certs/https-8443.crt
